title: Rwanda's 2035 Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0)
temporal_coverage: Historical climate/disaster information and projections through 2050 reported in 2025
methodology: NDC compiles national climate records, cited studies and adaptation priorities.
limitations: Cited disaster estimates do not establish climate effects on conflict.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Rwanda - Technical Appendix
temporal_coverage: Modeled crop and macroeconomic impacts under climate scenarios through 2050 and 2100
methodology: Technical appendix uses Rwanda-specific crop, labor, health and flood damage functions in a computable general-equilibrium model.
limitations: Scenario-dependent model using CMIP5 projections and a 2017 social accounting matrix; results are not observed impacts.

title: Assessing Community Vulnerability to Landslide and Flood in Northwestern Rwanda
organization: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction; UCLouvain repository
temporal_coverage: Household survey conducted May-July 2023; article published 2025.
methodology: Repository abstract reports a 904-household survey across 50 cells and principal component analysis.
limitations: Only the repository abstract was inspected; its linked full-text PDF returned HTTP 502, and the abstract does not name the higher-risk cells.

title: Climate vulnerability in Rwanda
temporal_coverage: District assessment published in 2026; the publisher page describes change over the previous five years without specifying those years.
methodology: Publisher summary describes mixed quantitative and qualitative research on district climate vulnerability and grassroots policy implementation.
limitations: The publisher page's detailed summary was inspected, but its linked full report download failed; the summary omits the sample design and index formula.

title: Rwanda NDC Deep Dive: Advancing Financial Innovation to Scale up Climate Action (P172153), Implementation Completion and Results Report
temporal_coverage: Implementation and results of the NDC Deep Dive project through 2024.
methodology: World Bank completion report reviews the project's outputs, implementation, outcome indicators, and lessons.
limitations: Project-specific results do not establish national adaptation effects; the report notes that the weather-information system's use and effectiveness could not be verified.

title: Rwanda Emergency Connectivity Restoration Project (RECOR): Environmental and Social Management Framework (Draft)
temporal_coverage: Draft project framework dated December 2024; includes May 2023 disaster impacts and planned reconstruction measures.
methodology: Draft project environmental and social management framework with national and project-area baseline information and planned risk-management measures.
limitations: Draft and project-specific; some subproject locations were not identified. Its border-conflict statement is contextual, not causal analysis.

title: World Bank Steps Up Support to Increase Rwanda's Resilience to Natural Disasters
methodology: World Bank announcement of approved disaster-risk financing and its intended policy pillars.
limitations: The announcement describes approved support and intended systems, not completed activities or measured household outcomes.
